architectural_units.name: Client
architectural_units.description: The client is the user of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Backend
architectural_units.description: The server is the software that is responsible for processing user requests.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for displaying information to the user.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer is the core of the application and is responsible for processing all the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for storing all the data.

architectural_units.name: API Gateway
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for the management, authentication and authorization of platform users.

architectural_units.name: Core
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for performing the business logic of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Analytical Module
architectural_units.description: This service has the main function of obtaining and processing data from playlogs, connections, and platform actions.

architectural_units.name: API Player
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for communicating with the players, receiving all the information corresponding to them.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Backend framework used to develop the different services.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: Programming language used for the backend development.

architectural_units.name: MySQL
architectural_units.description: Relational database used to store all the data necessary for the operation of the system.

architectural_units.name: Amazon RDS
architectural_units.description: AWS service used to implement the MySQL database.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: AWS object storage service used to store JSON documents containing playlogs, connections, and audit trail.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: AWS NoSQL database service used to store playlogs in real time.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: Service that allows performing SQL queries on data stored in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: Serverless data integration service used for metadata storage.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Service for data ingestion and processing, used to transmit playlogs and audit trail data.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: Service used for loading large amounts of data into data stores.

architectural_units.name: Player
architectural_units.description: A device that can be internal or external, which allows screens to play content.
La capa de presentació es comunica amb la capa de negoci, més concretament amb l’Api Gateway, mitjançant el protocol HTTP.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: La comunicació entre els dos components es realitza a través d’internet mitjançant el protocol HTTP [26] i el model de REST API.

La comunicació entre el servei de l’Api Gateway és mitjançant el protocol de comunicació TCP [29]. Cadascun d’aquests serveis tenen funcionalitats específiques: [...] Servei Api Gateway: [...] processa les peticions per poder enviar-les al servei Core i al mòdul analític.

architectural_units.name: TCP
architectural_units.description: Com es pot observar en la figura 9.1 la comunicació entre el servei de l’Api Gateway és mitjançant el protocol de comunicació TCP [29].
Aquest servei [Web Socket] s’encarrega de realitzar la comunicació entre la plataforma i els players, i d’aquesta manera permet l’intercanvi d’informació entre ells.

architectural_units.name: Web socket
architectural_units.description: Un web socket és la tecnologia que permet la comunicació bidireccional entre la plataforma i els players, i d’aquesta manera permet l’intercanvi d’informació entre ells.

El microservei WebSocket, que és qui s’encarrega de rebre la informació dels players. [...] Kinesis Data Streams per poder transmetre les dades dels playlogs [...] el generador el microservei WebSocket
L’audit trail té com a generador el Core, que és el microservei central de la plataforma. [...] Kinesis Data Streams per poder transmetre [...] l’audit trail
Per part dels consumidors tenim el servei de Kinesis Data Firehose, que s’encarrega de guardar les dades en el S3.
El servei d’Amazon Athena és un servei que permet realitzar consultes en SQL sobre dades emmagatzemades en Amazon S3.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture.

patterns.name: Layered Architecture
patterns.description: The client-server model uses a 3-layer architecture, where the system is divided into 3 layers.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform.
